name: IBM Watson Natural Language Understanding
tagline: Sentiment, entities, categories, and emotion analysis API from IBM Watson.
description: IBM Watson Natural Language Understanding (NLU) analyzes text for sentiment, entities, categories, keywords, emotion, and more. Developers call a regional REST API with features selected per request. It is suited for content moderation, brand monitoring, support triage, and structured extraction from unstructured text.

auth.details: IBM Cloud IAM: API key as Basic auth username (password empty), or Bearer IAM access token. Instance URL is region-specific.

example.request: curl -X POST -u "apikey:YOUR_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"text":"IBM is an American multinational technology company.","features":{"sentiment":{},"entities":{"sentiment":true}}}' "https://api.us-south.natural-language-understanding.watson.cloud.ibm.com/instances/YOUR_INSTANCE_ID/v1/analyze?version=2022-04-07"

use_cases: analyze sentiment of product reviews or support tickets
extract named entities and relations from news or documents
classify text into content categories for routing
detect emotion signals in customer feedback
extract keywords and concepts for tagging content
